questions: Have you ever had a seizure before this one?
Did you experience any warning or strange sensation just before the seizure started?
Do you have weakness in any part of your body right now?
Have you ever had a serious head injury, stroke, or brain surgery?
Do you have a family history of epilepsy?
Do you drink alcohol heavily or have you recently stopped drinking?
Do you use any recreational drugs?
Did you bite your tongue during the seizure?
Have you had a fever or felt unwell in the past few days?
Did the seizure occur shortly after waking from sleep?
Did you lose control of your bladder during the seizure?

dx_raw:
DIAGNOSIS: Genetic (idiopathic) generalized epilepsy, most consistent with juvenile myoclonic epilepsy

Alternatives:
1. Generalized epilepsy with generalized tonic-clonic seizures alone (without myoclonic component, as not directly confirmed)
2. Focal epilepsy with rapid secondary bilateral synchrony on EEG
3. Unclassified generalized epilepsy pending longer-term EEG/video-telemetry to capture a typical event and characterize the body turning (versive movement)
